@dogecoin_empire @coinbase Based purely on popularity, they may some day. But I could see coins like LUNA or THETA being added much earlier do to stronger fundamentals on their respective blockchains and associated companies. I'm holding doge but I'm not banking on it mooning at a steady rate.
